# NetLicensing Wiki

> Documentation for Labs64 NetLicensing, a licensing-as-a-service (LaaS) platform for software vendors: licensing models (node-locked, floating, subscription, rental, pay-per-use, quota, pricing table, discount and more), RESTful API, client libraries, Shop, Customer Portal, Agent, MCP server and integrations.

{{ site.software.description }}

Each page below is a standalone HTML page. The Markdown sources are public at https://github.com/Labs64/wiki/tree/master/docs. For the most recent product changes read the changelog first. Machine-readable feed of the latest entries: {{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}

## Optional

- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification](https://netlicensing.io/NetLicensing-API/v2.x/netlicensing.yaml): Machine-readable description of the NetLicensing REST API
- [API Test Center](https://netlicensing.io/NetLicensing-API/): Try the REST API in the browser with the demo account
- [NetLicensing MCP server](https://github.com/Labs64/NetLicensing-MCP): Model Context Protocol server for managing NetLicensing from AI agents
- [Client libraries on GitHub](https://github.com/Labs64): Java, C#/.NET, PHP, JavaScript/Node.js, Kotlin and C++ wrappers for the REST API
